scientific_integrity: Standalone exact-arithmetic finite verifier checks all 4,096 supports, while the geometric exhaustion and ten-obstruction criterion are proved separately. General chamber algorithms and surface classification are acknowledged prior work.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-zero surface with I9+3I1 fibers only; no Mori-chamber, positive-characteristic or general elliptic-surface classification; literature priority provisional; no independent audit.
title: Ten forbidden negative supports and 3,326 Zariski chambers on the extremal rational elliptic surface with a nine-gon fiber
